description:
Search verified real estate listings in Batumi and Tbilisi (apartments, houses, commercial).
<hints>
- Returns compact objects with price_usd, price_sqm_usd, area_sqm, rooms, renovation_status, construction_stage, seller_type, heating_type, gas_status, is_heritage_zone, cadastral_code, year_built, developer_name, sea_view, distance_to_sea_m, has_gas, pets_allowed, no_summer_increase, address, latitude, longitude, photos, source_url, and canonical_url.
- Also returns top-level shortlist_url (single link opening these exact returned properties on Hotyata's split-screen map) and web_search_url (link to all matching results on the map). Always share shortlist_url or web_search_url with the user so they can view all listings on one map in a single click.
- When presenting results as a numbered list (#1, #2, ...), keep the same order as returned — the embedded interactive map widget numbers pins #1, #2, ... to match your text list.
- Geo search: Use bbox='min_lng,min_lat,max_lng,max_lat' or [min_lng, min_lat, max_lng, max_lat] to search within a map rectangle.
- Batumi districts: 'Old Batumi', 'Rustaveli', 'Khimshiashvili' (New Boulevard), 'Bagrationi', 'Javakhishvili', 'Agmashenebeli', 'Airport', 'Tamar', 'Makhinjauri', 'Gonio', 'Kvariati', 'Chakvi', 'Kobuleti'.
- Tbilisi districts: 'Vake', 'Saburtalo', 'Vera', 'Mtatsminda', 'Chugureti' (Marjanishvili), 'Didube', 'Avlabari', 'Ortachala', 'Isani', 'Samgori', 'Gldani', 'Didi Dighomi', 'Old Tbilisi'.
- Use sort='cheapest' or 'cheapest_sqm' to find the best deals without fetching multiple pages.
- Use fields=['id','title','price_usd','price_sqm_usd','area_sqm','district','canonical_url'] to minimize token usage.
- Filter by source channel/portal/group using sources=['facebook marketplace'], ['ss.ge', 'myhome.ge'], ['@batumiarendachat'], or Facebook group URLs ['https://www.facebook.com/groups/278563704483455/']. Unmonitored sources return an error.
</hints>

bbox.description: Bounding box rectangle: 'min_lng,min_lat,max_lng,max_lat' or [min_lng, min_lat, max_lng, max_lat]

construction_stage.description: Filter by building stage (comma-separated allowed): 'off_plan' (katlavan / foundation / 2027+), 'under_construction', 'completed' (ready building)

deal_type.description: Type of deal: 'sale', 'rent_long' (long-term monthly rent), 'rent_daily' (short-term daily rent), or 'pledge' (mortgage/lease)

district.description: District name or comma-separated list of districts (e.g. 'Old Batumi,Rustaveli' or 'Saburtalo,Vake')

exclude_orbi.description: Exclude high-density Orbi City aparthotel listings

fields.description: Optional array of field names to include in each property object to save context tokens

has_gas.description: Must have gas connection / gas heating

is_heritage_zone.description: Filter properties located in Cultural Heritage Protection Zone (Old Batumi)

max_distance_to_metro.description: Maximum distance to metro in meters (Tbilisi)

max_distance_to_sea.description: Maximum distance to the sea in meters (e.g. 150 for first line, 500)

max_price.description: Maximum total price in selected currency

max_price_sqm.description: Maximum price per square meter in selected currency

min_distance_to_sea.description: Minimum distance to the sea in meters

min_price.description: Minimum total price in selected currency

min_price_sqm.description: Minimum price per square meter in selected currency

no_summer_increase.description: Rentals with fixed year-round price (no summer hike)

property_type.description: Property type filter (defaults to excluding parking)

query.description: Keywords to search in title, description, street, or amenities (e.g. 'seaview', 'panoramic', 'owner', 'urgent')

renovation_status.description: Filter by condition (comma-separated allowed): 'black_frame' (black box), 'white_frame' (white box), 'green_frame', 'renovated' (turnkey), 'needs_renovation'

rooms.description: Number of rooms (e.g. 1 for studio/1-room, 2, 3, or comma-separated '2,3')

sea_view.description: Sea view filter: 'full' (panoramic), 'partial' (side), 'any' (full or partial), or 'none'

seller_type.description: Filter by seller type: 'owner' (direct owner, no commission), 'developer', or 'agent'

sources.description: Filter by one or more source channels, platforms, portals, or Facebook group URLs. Examples: ['facebook marketplace'], ['ss.ge', 'myhome.ge'], ['https://www.facebook.com/groups/278563704483455/']

name: search_real_estate
